method.transform_family: V(x)=k*RSYC((x-s)/alpha) with ramp toe; QC adds a post-peak decline
method.bc_applied_rule: 10-150 unless primary alpha hits the 5.0 upper bound; then 1-250
method.qc_decline_selection: linear if R2>=0.97, else power if R2>=0.97, else stretched exponential
method.level_policy: preserve RSYC V100, or raw peak when V100 is not meaningful
method.donor_k_policy: donor k discarded; k is solved per receiver for level preservation

contract.pass: structurally sound and inside the donor-basis CMAI band
contract.flag: usable with provenance; expected for distant/extrapolated donors
contract.fail: not usable; structural or hard-band failure
contract.distant_donor: provenance flag only; not a failure
contract.parameter_at_bound: flags a fitted parameter at its accepted bound
contract.cmai_band: soft donor-basis band; hard-band violation is a fail
contract.step4_use: use rows with usable=true (pass + flag); do not use fail rows
